body.contents:
Special blocks for map building

Mob Blocker Pane:
An invisible magenta stained glass pane. Place on top of fences or iron bars to prevent mobs from jumping over. Blocks both mob pathfinding and physical movement. Bullets pass through it. Connects like fences for aligned collision.

Power Lamp Marker:
Places a marker-driven redstone lamp. This uses item-frame placement and aligns to block center like trap frames.
